The '''marsune''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of long-[[Death/Legends|extinct]] behemoth that lived [[Water/Legends|underwater]] on<ref name="GCG" /> the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Marsune was also used as a surname among the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] species on Naboo.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The marsune was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
